{{Otheruses|Voor|more=Cat}}
'''Voorcats''' were predators native to [[Yanibar]]. They hunted in packs and sometimes posed a threat to the colonists there. The [[Zeison Sha]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-users were trained to fend them off.
